mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_activity_snapshot (snapshot_date, group_name, campus, member_count, total_entries) VALUES (#{snapshotDate}, #{groupName}, #{campus}, #{memberCount}, #{totalEntries}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campus = VALUES(campus), member_count = VALUES(member_count), total_entries = VALUES(total_entries)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_activity_snapshot WHERE snapshot_date = #{snapshotDate}
